skills.name: Talking about progress in science; reading about telehealth

note.text:
Text: A hospital in my bedroom
When my grandfather's heart problem came back, we did not travel to the city. A nurse from the health centre brought a small machine and attached it to his chest. The recording was sent by phone to a heart specialist three hundred kilometres away, who read it within an hour and changed his medicine. This is telehealth: using phones, computers and the internet to give health care at a distance. In some big hospitals, robots now help surgeons to operate with great precision, and computers help doctors to read X-rays. But machines do not replace people: the nurse still came to our house, explained everything and held my grandfather's hand.

Words: technology, invention, a robot, telehealth (telemedicine), a specialist, a device, at a distance, precision.

worked_example.problem: What is telehealth, according to the text?
steps: Find the sentence that begins “This is telehealth”.
Using phones, computers and the internet to give health care at a distance.
worked_example.answer: health care at a distance using phones, computers and the internet

questions.prompt: Text “A hospital in my bedroom”. Which statement is wrong?

right.text: The nurse brought a small machine.
Robots help surgeons in big hospitals.

wrong.text: The family travelled three hundred kilometres to the city.
wrong.explain: They did not travel; the recording did.

wrong.text: The writer thinks robots should replace nurses.
wrong.explain: The writer says machines do not replace people.

wrong.text: The specialist took three days to read the recording.
wrong.explain: He read it within an hour.
